description: Repository-local copy of the shared verJSON Renovate policy (Verjson/renovate-config default.json), because the hosted Renovate app cannot resolve the private organization preset from this public repository — Verjson/renovate-config#7. Keep this file in step with the preset whenever that policy changes; the copy exists only until #7 lands a central distribution path that public adopters can consume. The preset's npm.pkg.github.com hostRules entry and @verjson registry mapping are deliberately omitted: a public repository's hosted run receives no organization secret, so referencing one here would fail the run rather than authenticate it.

packageRules.description: Internal @verjson/* runtime bumps: auto-merge and republish (fix) so the umbrella propagates.
Internal @verjson/* dev/peer bumps: auto-merge without a release.
Auto-merge non-major external updates on green CI (after the stability delay).
Hold major updates for a human — keep them on the Dependency Dashboard, no PR until approved.
Peer ranges are published contracts: widen them without raising their existing floor, and require explicit approval for any proposed change.
The published Node engine is a support contract: widen it without raising the existing floor, and require explicit approval for any proposed change.

Hold TypeScript below 7 while the native compiler cannot resolve this organization's NodeNext interfaces and typescript-eslint requires TypeScript <6.1; remove only after both blockers clear (Verjson/renovate-config#3).
Workflow Node versions are contract inputs derived from package engines, not dependencies Renovate may resolve.
Generated changelog validation and release workflow pins move only through the canonical generator's complete artifact set.
Keep major and non-major updates for each GitHub Action on one branch.
